# WiFi Print v2.0

> Free, private, open-source wireless printing system from Android to any Windows PC printer over Wi-Fi.

WiFi Print is a high-performance cross-platform wireless printing solution. It turns any Windows 10 or 11 PC into an instant wireless print bridge for Android devices. Print PDFs, password-protected files, Microsoft Office documents, photos, and scans directly to any installed printer (USB, network, or virtual PDF) — with zero cloud dependency, no cables, and no subscriptions.

## Key Features & Breakthroughs (v2.0)

- **Universal Wi-Fi Printing**: Print PDF, DOCX, DOC, TXT, and images (JPEG, PNG, WebP) directly from Android to any Windows printer.
- **On-Device ML Kit OCR**: Real-time optical character recognition powered by Google ML Kit running 100% on-device. Extract text, search documents, and copy text offline.
- **Continuous Batch Document Scanner**: Capture multi-page documents, invoices, or books continuously without returning to menus. Reorder pages and export as a single multi-page PDF.
- **Post-Scan Editing Studio**: 90° rotation, interactive rule-of-thirds perspective crop, brightness & contrast sliders, document filters (Auto Enhance, B&W, High Contrast, Sharp, Grayscale), custom watermarks, and multi-format page sizing (A4, US Letter, Legal, A3).
- **ID Card Auto-Merge**: Scan front and back sides of ID cards; automatically aligns and merges both onto a single printable page.
- **Password-Protected PDF Support**: Direct on-device decryption and local printing of password-locked bank e-statements, salary slips, and invoices.
- **Cross-Network & Subnet Pairing**: Instant zero-config auto-connect on the same Wi-Fi subnet; permanent QR code and 6-digit rotating PIN pairing across different subnets, VLANs, or guest Wi-Fi networks.
- **Redesigned Windows Desktop Dashboard**: Modern 2-column dashboard with live queue progress, printer discovery, and dynamic high-priority device connection approval banners.
- **100% Local & Private (Zero Cloud)**: Operates entirely over local area network (LAN) using encrypted TLS (HTTPS) and JWT authentication. No telemetry, no external servers, and no internet required.
- **Real-Time WebSockets**: Live print job status, progress percentages, and error notifications via SignalR.
- **Share-to-Print**: Android system-level share sheet integration allows printing from WhatsApp, Gmail, Chrome, Google Drive, or any file viewer.

## Supported Hardware & Compatibility

- **Printers**: Any printer working with Windows 10/11, including HP (LaserJet, DeskJet, OfficeJet), Canon (PIXMA, imageCLASS), Epson (EcoTank), Brother, Samsung, Xerox, Ricoh, Lexmark, Kyocera, POS thermal receipt printers, and virtual PDF printers.
- **Mobile Client**: Android 8.0 (Oreo) through Android 14+.
- **Desktop Server**: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit) with .NET 8 Runtime.

## Setup Guide

1. Download and run the WiFi Print Server on your Windows PC.
2. Open the WiFi Print app on your Android phone.
3. If on the same Wi-Fi, it auto-connects. If on separate subnets, scan the desktop QR code or enter the 6-digit PIN.
4. Select or scan your document and print instantly.
